outcome: Fresh source-current matched baseline and hostile-ecology feature workloads completed end-to-end after narrow harness repair. The comparison is valid at its finite native evidence ceiling: repeated native action/update intervals and one identity-bound CPU/RSS interval per workload were captured; raw renderer pacing distribution and repeated resource samples remain open.
summary: Brief digest verified. Current source-bound tiles build completed. New R-036 baseline and feature manifests preserve equivalent McWilliams living-base fixtures and identical native movement plus six one-minute waits, differing only in hostile-ecology load. The first reruns exposed and repaired two harness defects: direct menu.choose dropped advertised stable IDs, and adaptive receipt validation rejected internal native frame IDs despite requested-frame binding. Focused tests passed; fresh reruns then completed all 8/8 steps for both workloads. OCR was not used as proof; no prior R-028 result was replayed. Both game PIDs were explicitly routed through native save/quit and quit confirmation; current ps checks found them absent, but broker OS exit is not independently evidenced beyond run-local writer traces.

evidence_ceiling: A valid finite matched comparison was produced: 27 repeated native inter-receipt intervals per workload (baseline median 172 ms, p95 275 ms, max 292 ms; feature median 169 ms, p95 279 ms, max 290 ms), plus one identity-bound CPU/RSS interval per workload (baseline 19.236% / 1,127,432,192 bytes; feature 19.852% / 1,127,858,176 bytes).
Raw renderer pacing distribution and repeated CPU/RSS samples beyond one interval per workload were not captured; no universal performance target or regression label is inferred.
Movement receipts and loaded living-base/hostile operation observations are mechanical/setup evidence only; they do not prove integrated performance or gameplay feel.
OCR, screenshots, terminal/rendered text, startup, fixture installation and accepted input were not used as gameplay proof.

PID birth identities are retained in each probe report and current OS absence was checked after native quit, but no durable broker PID/birth/exit artifact was retained for these runs; broker lifecycle evidence ceiling is current absence plus run-local writer identities, not independently proven graceful broker exit.
No automatic time/RSS termination was used.
